messages:
alex_chang: quick async standup — SDKs / quickstarts / sample apps / doc fixes. Drop a one-liner: 1) what you did yesterday 2) blockers 3) plan for today. I’ll triage PRs after replies. TL;DR: priority is node quickstart packaging flake + sample app config.

maria_gonzalez: Yesterday: landed node quickstart 0.7, updated CLI examples and embed snippet. Blockers: CI mac wheel build flakes — seeing a failing test 'test_packaging_timeout' on macos-latest. Trying to repro locally. Plan: isolate the test, add a fallback timeout, open PR to skip if flaky. :eyes:

kyle_wu: Yesterday: ran e2e on sample demo app and found telemetry env var mismatch causing startup warning. Blockers: waiting on sampleapp-config secrets from infra (ticket #3421). Plan: add a README note about TELEMETRY env and push a small config loader patch after infra confirms secrets.

samira: Yesterday: finished docs review for SDK auth section and merged wording fixes. Blockers: none. Today: will proofread quickstarts, add streaming responses + function-calling snippet, and review Maria's packaging PR.

alex_chang: Thanks — quick followups: @maria_gonzalez if you can’t repro I’ll run the mac CI locally later today. @kyle_wu I can ping infra on #infra-ops about ticket 3421. Can you paste the config diff here? :thumbsup:

kyle_wu: snippet pasted: ```env.sample
- REDWOOD_TELEMETRY=false
+ REDWOOD_TELEMETRY=0
``` Also opened PR 5523 with the change: https://github.com/redwood-inference/samples/pull/5523

maria_gonzalez: FYI reproduced the flake locally — looks like a race in the packaging script where the artifact is read before finalize step. Temp fix in PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/4012 — skips the flaky test on macos-12 and adds a TODO to improve the finalize ordering. Will add a note in the release checklist. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

samira: LGTM on PR 4012, left an inline suggestion to clarify the error log. Planning to add streaming example with function calling to quickstart doc today and link to sample app.

alex_chang: I’ll merge once CI goes green. Also low priority ask: can we add a weekly smoke run for quickstarts in sampleapps CI (minimal end-to-end)? Would catch packaging regressions earlier. @devex-bot please create a tracking issue for weekly smoke test.

devex-bot: devex-bot created issue #412 in infra/ci to add weekly smoke test (assigned to devex-team). https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/issues/412

kyle_wu: One more ask — can docs add Rust SDK syntax highlighting for quickstarts? I’ll port the example and open a PR today.

maria_gonzalez: Drafted packaging notes PR for the release checklist and linked the flaky test context: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1287 (WIP).

alex_chang: great — thanks team. If anything stalls beyond infra/CI, ping me directly. I’ll do a midday sweep and merge quick fixes if green. :rocket:
